sloka: तथोक्तो धर्मशीलेन भ्रात्रा तस्य हिते रत:।लक्ष्मण: प्रविवेशेव स्वानि गात्राणि लज्जया ॥ २.९७.१९॥
transliteration: tathokto dharmaśīlena bhrātrā tasya hite rata:।lakṣmaṇa: praviveśeva svāni gātrāṇi lajjayā ॥ 2.97.19॥

translations.english: Having heard the words uttered by his brother, Rama of virtuous disposition, Lakshmana who was devoted to his brother's welfare, shrank.
